origin.says: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 隹 (short-tailed bird) as the sound: who. Simplified from 誰, with 言 (speech) written 讠.
Simplified Chinese took over the old character 价 (servant: 亻 person + 介 go-between as the sound) for 價 (price: 亻 person + 賈 trade). Now: price, value.

获.def: to get, to obtain, to receive, to sieze

origin.says: Simplified from both 獲 (犭 dog + 蒦 sound: to catch in a hunt) and 穫 (禾 grain + 蒦: to harvest). 蒦 was cut down to 艹 on top and 犬 (dog) on the right.

获.name: capture

跟.def: heel; to accompany, to follow; with

origin.says: 𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 艮 (stubborn) as the sound: the heel, and from walking at someone's heels, 'to follow, with'.

跟.name: heel

ety.hint: Three people 人 representing a crowd

origin.says: Three 人 (person) together: a crowd. The traditional 眾 put an eye-like top (once a sun) over the people; the simplified form is an old variant with only the three people.

ety.hint: Simplified form of 樂, a musical instrument with wood 木, strings 幺, and a pick 白

origin.says: Traditional 樂 draws strings on a wooden frame, a stringed instrument; so music, and the joy it brings. The simplified 乐 comes from a cursive form.

收.def: to collect, to gather, to harvest

origin.says: 攵 (a hand with a stick, action) for the meaning plus 丩 (entwined cords) as the sound: first to arrest someone, then to collect or gather.

收.name: gather in

origin.says: 辶 (walking, movement) for the meaning plus 斤 (axe) as the sound: only a short walk away, near.

ety.hint: A giant 大 with a normal-sized man 丶 for scale

origin.says: A form of 大 (big) with an extra dot to mark 'very big, too big'. In old texts 大 (big), 太 (too) and 泰 (great) were used interchangeably.

育.def: to produce, to give birth to; to educate

ety.hint: A pregnant woman with a baby ⺼ in her womb

origin.says: An upside-down child (the top, 亠 over 厶) above 月 (flesh, body): a baby being born. Hence to give birth, to raise, to educate.

育.name: birth

ety.hint: A person kneeling 匕 before a corpse 歹

origin.says: 歹 (broken bones) beside 匕 (a kneeling person): a person by the remains of the dead, death. One reading instead takes a body shape as the sound.

图.def: diagram, chart, map, picture; to plan

ety.hint: Simplified form of 圖; a map of a district's 啚 borders 囗

origin.says: Simplified from 圖: 囗 (border) around 啚 (outlying land): a map of a territory; hence a picture, to plan. The simplified form replaces 啚 with 冬 (winter), a stand-in shape.

图.name: map

ety.hint: A child 子 in a house 宀; 子 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 宀 (roof) over 子 (child), which also gives the sound: first to bear and raise a child at home. It came to mean 'written character', compound characters being seen as born from simpler ones.
木 (wood) for the meaning plus 各 (each) as the sound: first a wooden frame or bar, hence a grid, pattern, standard.

消.def: news, rumors; to die out, to melt away, to vanish

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 肖 as the sound: to melt or put out with water, hence to vanish, eliminate; also news.

消.name: vanish

费.def: expenses, fees; to cost, to spend; wasteful

origin.says: 弗 (not) as the sound plus 贝 (cowry shell, money): spending money, fees. Simplified from 費 (貝 became 贝).

费.name: fee

供.def: to supply, to provide for; to offer in worship

ety.hint: A person 亻 making an offering with both hands 共; 共 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 共 (two hands offering) as the sound and meaning: to supply, to provide, to make an offering.

供.name: supply

照.def: to shine, to reflect, to illuminate

origin.says: 灬 (fire) for the meaning plus 昭 (bright) as the sound and meaning: to shine light on, to illuminate; hence also to reflect and to photograph.

照.name: shine light

origin.says: 纟 (silk thread) for the meaning plus 及 (reach) as the sound: first an ordered series in silk work, then a step, level or grade. Simplified from 級 (糹 to 纟).

整.def: neat, orderly, whole; to repair, to mend

origin.says: 敕 (to order, put in order) for the meaning plus 正 (upright) as the sound: set in order, neat, whole.

整.name: tidy

ety.hint: Hair 彡 growing on the face 页

origin.says: From 須, a picture of a face with a beard, later read as 彡 (hair) beside 頁 (head). 'Must' is a sound loan. The simplified form writes 頁 as 页 and also replaces 鬚 (beard, 須 with 髟 hair added).
Simplified from 頭 (head): 頁 (head) for the meaning plus 豆 (bean) as the sound. 头 is a cursive shorthand of the whole character: 豆 became the two dots and 頁 became 大 (big).

称.def: balanced; name, brand; to say, to call

origin.says: Simplified from 稱: 禾 (grain) for the meaning plus 爯 (a hand lifting) as the sound: to weigh grain; hence to state, to call. The simplified form replaces 爯 with 尔, from a popular variant 穪.

称.name: call by name

origin.says: A drawing of an elephant standing on end: the top is the trunk, then the head, then the body and legs. The word was also used for 'image, likeness'.

失.def: to lose; to make a mistake, to neglect

ety.hint: Something 丿 falling from a hand 夫

origin.says: Origin disputed. The old dictionary, followed by CUHK, reads 手 (hand) with 乙 as a sound part: something slipping from the hand, to lose. Wiktionary notes early forms show no hand and sees a fallen person's footprint.
origin.src: CUHK; Wiktionary (local copy); Dong Chinese (local copy)

失.name: lose

走.def: to walk, to run, to flee

ety.hint: Someone 土 stepping with their foot 止

origin.says: A person running with swinging arms (now 土) over a foot 止 (now 龰): to run. The modern meaning walk, go came later.

走.name: walk
走.in: 起超越趣赶徒趋赴趁赵趟陡

查.def: to investigate, to examine, to look into

origin.says: First written 査: 木 (tree) for the meaning plus 且 (altar) as the sound, naming the hawthorn and a raft. The bottom was later stylised into 旦 (dawn); 'to check' is a borrowed sense.

查.name: check

响.def: to make noise, to make sound; sound

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 向 (toward) as the sound: a sound, an echo. 向 first wrote this word; the traditional 響 is 音 (sound) plus 鄉 (village) as the sound, replaced by a new simpler build.

响.name: loud sound

究.def: to dig into, to investigate; actually, after all

origin.says: 穴 (cave, hole) for the meaning plus 九 (nine) as the sound: to go to the bottom of a hole, to investigate thoroughly; 'after all'.

究.name: investigate

喜.def: to love; to enjoy, to be happy; joyful, glad

ety.hint: Singing 口 and beating drums 壴

origin.says: 壴 (a drum on a stand) over 口 (mouth): drumming and singing, so joy, to be glad, to like.

喜.name: happy drum

origin.says: One reading: 亻 (person) plus 更 (change): a person changes posture to be comfortable, hence convenient. Another reading: originally a person holding a whip (the source of 鞭 (whip)).

识.def: knowledge; to understand, to recognize, to know

origin.says: Simplified from 識: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 戠 as the sound: to know, to recognize. 言 became 讠 and the complex 戠 was replaced by 只 (only).

识.name: knowledge

具.def: tool, implement; to draw up, to write

ety.hint: Two hands 八 writing on a tablet 目

origin.says: Two hands holding up a cooking cauldron: to prepare a meal, then tools and utensils. The cauldron shrank to a 目 (eye) shape and the hands to two strokes below; the old dictionary took it for a shell.

具.name: tool
具.in: 真镇俱惧填慎颠篡滇巅

origin.says: Simplified from 質: two 斤 (axe) over 貝 (cowry shell, money); the old dictionary gives the parts but leaves the build unexplained (perhaps goods pledged, or the axes as the sound). The top was cut to a shape like 𠂆 and 十, and 貝 became 贝.

ety.hint: An animal standing straight; 亠 is the head

origin.says: A picture of a horned mountain demon with a tail. It stood for the sound in 離 (bird; borrowed for 'leave'), and the simplification took over 离 for 'to leave', dropping 隹 (bird).
Simplified from 萬, a drawing of a scorpion, borrowed for its sound to mean ten thousand. 万 is an old short form whose own origin is unclear.

ety.hint: Soldiers 冖 (distorted 力) in a cart 车

origin.says: Traditional 軍: 車 (chariot) under a covering part. One reading has chariots encircled in a camp, hence army; another takes the top as a sound part. The simplified form writes 車 as 车.

亲.def: relatives, parents; intimate; the hazelnut tree

ety.hint: A tree 木 bearing fruit 立

origin.says: Traditional 親 is 見 (see) for the meaning plus 亲 (辛 chisel with 木 tree, a variant of 辛) as the sound: those you see closely, kin. The simplified form drops 見; 辛 now looks like 立 (stand).

亲.name: kin

言.def: words, speech; to speak, to say

ety.hint: A tongue sticking out of a mouth 口

origin.says: A mouth 口 with a tongue or a line coming out of it: speech, words. One reading instead sees a mouth blowing a pipe; the top looks like 辛 (bitter) in later script.

言.name: words
言.in: 信警誉誓譬赡瞻誊檐唁

找.def: to search for, to look for, to find; change (as in money)

ety.hint: To go searching with a spear 戈 in hand 扌

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 戈 (dagger-axe) as the sound; first a variant of 划 (to row), later borrowed for 'to look for'. 'A hand searching for a weapon' is only a mnemonic.

找.name: look for

观.def: to observe, to spectate; appearance, view

ety.hint: To see 见 again 又

origin.says: Simplified from 觀: 見 (see) for the meaning plus 雚 as the sound: to look at, to observe. The simplified form writes 見 as 见 and replaces 雚 with the stand-in 又.

观.name: observe

origin.says: 宀 (roof) over 㠯 (a shape standing for mounds or a host of people): an official building, then the official who works there. One reading takes the lower part as short for 師 (master), another as rooms under one roof.

构.def: to compose, to make; building, frame, structure

origin.says: Traditional 構: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 冓 (framework) as the sound: a timber frame, to build. Simplified by replacing 冓 with 勾 (hook) as the sound.

构.name: framework

企.def: to plan a project; to stand on tiptoe

ety.hint: A man 人 on his feet 止; 止 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 人 (person) above 止 (foot): a person standing on tiptoe to look ahead, hence to hope for and to plan. Its use for companies and enterprise is modern.

企.name: tiptoe

算.def: to calculate, to count; to figure, to plan

origin.says: 𥫗 (bamboo) over 目, perhaps counting rods, over 廾 (two hands): handling bamboo counting rods, to calculate.

算.name: reckon

推.def: to push; to expel; to drive; to decline

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 隹 (short-tailed bird) as the sound: to push with the hand.

推.name: push

ety.hint: To walk 彳 as required by law 聿

origin.says: 彳 (step, road) for the meaning plus 聿 (brush) as the sound: the rules by which people go, law. One source reads it as walking as the written rule says.

投.def: to pitch, to throw; to bid, to invest

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 殳 (hand with a weapon) as the sound: to throw with the hand; later to invest, cast a vote.

投.name: throw

origin.says: Simplified from 邊: 辶 (walking) plus 臱 as the sound, the edge or border. The simplified form put 力 (strength) in place of the sound part as a mere stand-in shape.

希.def: rare; to hope for, to strive for; to expect

origin.says: 爻 (crossed threads) over 巾 (cloth): an open-weave cloth, so sparse, rare; the meaning moved on to 'hope'. The lower cross of 爻 now looks like the top of 布 (cloth).

希.name: hope

增.def: to increase; to expand; to augment; to add

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 曾 (once before) as the sound: piling up earth, to increase.

增.name: increase

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 主 (master) as the sound: to pour into, and from that to fix attention on. Simplified 注 also took over 註 (to annotate, to register).

连.def: to join, to connect; continuous; even

ety.hint: A cart 车 moving 辶 goods between cities

origin.says: 辶 (walking) plus 车 (cart): carts pulled along one after the other, to link, in a row. Simplified from 連 with 車 in its short form.

连.name: in a row

括.def: to embrace, to enclose, to include

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus an old sound part (氏 over 口) that later took the shape of 舌 (tongue): to tie up, enclose, include.

括.name: include

ety.hint: A state 州 surrounded by water 氵; 州 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 氵 (water) plus 州 (province, first an islet), also the sound: land surrounded by water, an island, then a continent.
Simplified from 語: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 吾 (I) as the sound; 言 became 讠: words, language.

除.def: to eliminate, to remove, to wipe out

ety.hint: The waste 余 produced by a city 阝

origin.says: 阝 (mound, steps, from 阜) for the meaning plus 余 (surplus) as the sound: first the steps of a palace, then to clear away, to remove; also 'except'.

除.name: remove

ety.hint: Half of a tree trunk; compare 爿

origin.says: The mirror image of 爿 (plank bed); the old dictionary explains it as the right half of 木 (tree) split down the middle: a flat thin piece of wood, a slice.

够.def: enough, adequate; to reach, to attain; to pass muster

origin.says: 多 (many) for the meaning plus 句 (hooked) as the sound: much, enough. The traditional 夠 put 多 (many) on the left; the standard form swaps the sides.

够.name: enough

达.def: to reach, to arrive at; intelligent

origin.says: Simplified from 達: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 羍 (a lamb) as the sound, 'to reach'. The simplified form swaps 羍 for the simpler 大 (big), which also sounds close.

达.name: get there

ety.hint: Simplified form of 農, tilling the field 田 with a hoe 辰

origin.says: Simplified from 農: vegetation and 辰 (hoe), later with 田 (field), weeding the fields, farming. The parts changed shape over time, and 农 is a cursive form of the whole.

护.def: to defend, to guard, to protect; shelter; endorse

ety.hint: Guarding 扌 a home 户; 户 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: A new simplified form replacing 護 (言 speech + 蒦 as the sound): now 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 户 (door) as the sound: to guard, protect.

护.name: protect

origin.says: A drawing of an axe head standing on its edge, the sign of a warrior; the meaning moved from soldier to officer, scholar, gentleman.

士.name: scholar
士.in: 结声装志款洁吉壳壮壶壹桔秸馨

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 原 (origin, a spring under a cliff) as the sound and meaning: the source of a river, and so any source or root.

ety.hint: Border 冂 around land 土 with a well 口

origin.says: Oracle-bone forms drew a jade piece with carved patterns; 口 (mouth) was added when it became a country name (Zhou). Its top later came to look like 用 (use). Meanings: all around, circuit, and (taking over 週) week.
Simplified from 條 (twig): 攸 as the sound plus 木 (tree), a thin branch, hence long thin things. The simplified form drops 亻 and the stroke beside it, keeping 夂 over 木.

写.def: to write; to draw, to sketch; to compose

origin.says: Simplified from 寫: 宀 (roof) plus 舄 (magpie) as the sound, used for 'to write'. The simple form turned 宀 into 冖 (cover) and 舄 into 与 (give).

写.name: write

ety.hint: Money 贝 that must be repaid

origin.says: Simplified from 責: 朿 (thorn) as the sound over 貝 (cowry, money) for the meaning: a tax or debt owed, hence duty. The top now looks like 龶 and 貝 is simplified to 贝.

思.def: to think, to ponder, to consider; final particle

ety.hint: Weighing something with your mind 囟 (altered) and heart 心

origin.says: The top was 囟 (the soft spot of the skull) over 心 (heart): thinking with head and heart; one reading takes 囟 as the sound. The top later changed into a 田 (field) shape, unrelated to fields.

思.name: ponder

origin.says: 穴 (cave, hole) for the meaning plus 工 (work) as the sound: a hollow, empty; then sky and free time.

验.def: to examine, to inspect, to test, to verify

origin.says: 马 (horse) for the meaning plus 佥 (all) as the sound: first a kind of horse, then to examine, to test. Simplified from 驗 by the cursive horse 马 and the shortened 佥.

验.name: test

呢.def: wool; interrogative or emphatic final particle

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 尼 (nun) as the sound: written for a spoken particle ending questions; also used for woollen cloth.

呢.name: question tail

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 竟 (end) as the sound: where the land ends, a border; hence a region or situation.

ety.hint: Two people 从 together in a cart

origin.says: From 兩, which old forms show as two joined 丙 (yoke-like shape), often read as the double yoke of a two-horse chariot: two, a pair. The simplified form redraws the inside.

住.def: to reside, to live at, to dwell, to lodge; to stop

ety.hint: A person 亻 who hosts 主; 主 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 主 (master) as the sound: a person staying in one place, to stop, to live; a later character.

住.name: dwell

吃.def: to eat; to drink; to suffer, to endure, to bear

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 乞 (to beg) as the sound; it first meant 'to stutter'. It took over 'to eat' from the old character 喫 when that was merged into it.

吃.name: eat

息.def: to end, to cease, to put a stop to; pause, breath, rest; news

ety.hint: To breathe (life, 心) through one's nose 自; 心 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 自 (nose, its original meaning) plus 心 (heart), the lower part perhaps first lines of air: breath. From breathing came to rest, and also news.

息.name: breath

origin.says: The oldest forms draw a hanging bell-like musical instrument, open at the bottom; old texts still use 南 for such an instrument. It was borrowed for its sound to write 'south'. A newer reading sees a lidded vessel instead.

买.def: to buy, to purchase; to bribe, to persuade

origin.says: Simplified from 買: 网 (net) above 貝 (cowrie shell, money): gathering goods in with money, to buy. The simplified shape comes from cursive writing; the shell became 头.

买.name: buy

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 交 (to cross) as the sound, also suggesting crossed bars: first a wooden pen or stocks, later 'to check' and 'school'.

演.def: to perform, to act, to put on a play

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 寅 (third branch) as the sound: water flowing far, so to unfold, develop, and then to act out, perform.

演.name: perform

助.def: to help, to aid, to assist

origin.says: 且 (altar) as the sound plus 力 (strength) for the meaning: lending your strength, to help.

助.name: help

考.def: to test, to investigate, to examine

origin.says: A twin of 老 (old): 耂 (an old man with long hair) leaning on 丂 (a walking stick). It first meant an old man, a late father; 'to examine, to test' came later.

考.name: exam

研.def: to grind, to rub; to study, to research

origin.says: 石 (stone) for the meaning plus 幵 (an old sound part, now written like 开) as the sound: to grind on a stone, then to study closely.

研.name: grindstone

origin.says: 刑 (punishment) as the sound plus 土 (earth) for the meaning: an earthen mold, hence model, type.

ety.hint: Results produced by capable 力 labor 工; 工 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 工 (work) as the sound and meaning plus 力 (strength): work done with effort, achievement, merit.

ety.hint: A rice cooker on heat 日, building up steam 丷 and letting it off

origin.says: A picture of a steaming pot: steam on top, a grid, and the pot (later 甑 (steamer) took that meaning). It was borrowed for 'once, already'. The bottom 日 (sun) grew from a decorative 口 (mouth).
